from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] != background]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != background]
    def bands(n, seps):
        out=[]; start=0
        for s in seps:
            if start < s: out.append((start,s))
            start=s+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rb, cb = bands(h,row_seps), bands(w,col_seps)
    panels=[]
    for r0,r1 in rb:
        for c0,c1 in cb:
            p=[row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
            mode=Counter(x for row in p for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
            score=sum(x != mode for row in p for x in row)
            panels.append((score,r0,r1,c0,c1,p))
    _,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,source=max(panels,key=lambda z:z[0])
    for _,r0,r1,c0,c1,_ in panels:
        if r1-r0 == len(source) and c1-c0 == len(source[0]):
            for i in range(r1-r0):
                g[r0+i][c0:c1]=source[i][:]
    return g
'''
path=programs/'task-00cbe9fd.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path)
